No raw auth copied. Successful existing manifest.backupAttempt provides cross-reference without new manifest fields.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.contextActivation: Recorder reserved before source observation, but Docker instrumentation activated only around C/D and _restore E1-E9; reset token in finally. Production clients/exporter proofs untouched. No process-global monkeypatch.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.crash: Start without matching end proves dispatch intent only; classify incomplete/unknown, not nonzero, success or cleanup. No automatic recovery.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.durability: receipts.exclusive: O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW/0600, fsync file then parent. Follow with safe_file(private=True) checking uid/nlink1/regular/non-symlink/0600 and exact canonical raw hash. No overwrite/append of a finalized file; new immutable records only.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.fixtureRoot: Path(root).parent / backup-diagnostics / <attempt32hex>, only for validated fixture plan plus fixture transport; existing fixture passes owned TemporaryDirectory/backups. No production override.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.manifestSeparation: Outside backup root/attempt portable tree; no diagnostic file added to manifest.files or SHA256SUMS. exact-single-backup/2 exact required eight-file set and validation rules remain unchanged.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.productionRoot: ROOT / fixed profile.receiptRoot / backup-diagnostics / <existing capture_backup attempt32hex>
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.reservation: Initialize inside capture_backup guarded try/finally before exporter dispatch. mkdir attempt with exist_ok=false; collision fails without alternate ID. Validate private ancestry, mode0700/owner/no symlink; fsync newly created directories and parents.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.storageFailure: No retries/fallback sink. Retain durable prefix and in-memory primary plus persistence secondary; abort backup. Raise primary if present, otherwise fixed BACKUP_FAILED/DIAGNOSTIC_PERSISTENCE_FAILED. Disk/fsync failure may prevent terminal persistence: explicitly NOT_PERSISTED, never claim durable full evidence. Do not fabricate failure data or obscure primary with receipt exception.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.storageFailureVsPolling: Recorder failures use a distinct internal non-Failure exception to escape the existing except Failure readiness loop, then map at capture_backup boundary; do not consume extra probes or repeat a successful Docker operation.
diagnosticReceiptStrategy.terminalMeaning: LOCAL_PHASES_COMPLETED is not BACKUP_SUCCESS. FAILURE records authoritative primary plus secondary cleanup/persistence descriptors, phase statuses and hashes of prior durable receipts. E1-E9 failure cannot publish VALID manifest.

dockerDiagnosticContract.expectedReadiness: Individual readiness nonzero records remain evidence, not immediate terminal backup failure; retain exactly existing 100-probe loop and 0.1s sleeps. Exhaustion remains OWNED_DB_START. No newly added retry.
dockerDiagnosticContract.nonDockerFailure: Phase end/terminal descriptors record SQL protocol, identity, catalog/count mismatch separately. Never pretend a SQL failure with Docker rc0 was a nonzero Docker exit.
dockerDiagnosticContract.resultTypes: returnCode is actual int (including negative signal returncode), or null if spawn/timeout observation cannot supply it. timeout is boolean; timestamps numeric UTC seconds. IMAGE_ID pinned; network classification OWNED_NETWORK_NONE; safe container hash SHA256(UTF8 owned container name) or null for transient TOC tools.
dockerDiagnosticContract.spawnFailure: Returncode null, hashes null where unavailable, finite OS_SPAWN_FAILURE; original exception preserved process-local.
dockerDiagnosticContract.startRecord: completedAt/returnCode/hashes null until known; never substitute empty-stream hash for unobserved bytes.
dockerDiagnosticContract.streamCapture: _docker hashes bytes already returned by subprocess.run. On TimeoutExpired hash only available partial bytes and completeness=false. _Session hashes each raw chunk/line in existing stdout/stderr reader before protocol processing, retains no durable raw text, finalizes after existing close/wait/join sequence. If stream closure/reader join prevents complete capture, preserve partial digest and completeness=false and fail diagnostics; never change wait/kill/join timeouts.

failurePreservation.constructor: Do not move docker run into a new cleanup branch: failed run currently outside try remains outside. Within existing try, hold original primary exception; attempt close exactly once as current flow; catch secondary cleanup failure and attach its safe descriptor to recorder, then re-raise original primary object/traceback. No recovery cleanup retry.
failurePreservation.context: __exit__ with body primary P calls existing close once. If cleanup C fails, record P and C and return false to propagate P. With no body P, propagate C as authoritative failure. With neither, normal success. Never suppress required failure.
failurePreservation.nestedSession: Apply same preservation to _Session constructor and OwnedTransport._session finalizer when diagnostic context active; do not lose first observation/protocol failure to session close before OwnedCluster sees it. Retain ordered secondary list when both session close and cluster close fail.
failurePreservation.recordShape: primaryFailure:{phase,operationKind,state,code,invocationReceiptSha256|null}; cleanupSecondaryFailures:[same safe descriptors]; cleanupStatus:PASS|FAIL|NOT_REACHED|UNKNOWN; diagnosticPersistenceStatus:DURABLE|NOT_PERSISTED. Nullable code from unknown exception replaced with fixed UNKNOWN_EXCEPTION.
failurePreservation.successForbidden: Body failure, cleanup-only failure, required diagnostic durability failure or E8 mismatch always fail closed; no VALID manifest/restore success receipt. Preserve existing FAILED.json INVALID/code behavior; detailed records stored separately.
